resources.string: Optional zoom control below the camera while recording

Show a zoom slider below the round video camera while recording. Drag the control to change zoom within the active camera’s supported range. Works with the built-in Camera1, Camera2 and CameraX engines; the slider stays hidden when the camera does not support zoom.\n\nYou can turn this control off without disabling pinch-to-zoom or other zoom gestures. The setting is shared with Chats → Media → Round video zoom slider and applies the next time the camera opens. Your existing choice is preserved.
